objective: Use the vision simulator to understand how lens types differ by distance and lighting, then read the lens implant page — without being promised an outcome.
device: iPad Mini (Playwright descriptor: 768×1024, DPR 2, iPadOS UA) — rendered by Chromium
test: journeys\persona-h.spec.js › Persona H — comparing lens options

steps.action: Open the home page, tap "مختبر العدسات" in the navigation, then "محاكي الرؤية بكل أدواته"
steps.expected: Opens the Lens Lab page and jumps to the simulator section; the simulator loads in place

steps.action: Read the disclaimer under the viewer
steps.expected: An educational, not-a-prediction disclaimer is visible
steps.actual: visible=true: "رسم توضيحي تثقيفي — ليس توقعاً لرؤيتك؛ سيقدّم لك جرّاحك المشورة."

steps.action: Tap the lens buttons: EDOF, then trifocal, then monofocal
steps.expected: Each tap selects that lens; the explanation card follows
steps.actual: edof:"ممتدة العمق (EDOF)" | trifocal:"ثلاثية البؤرة" | monofocal:"أحادية البؤرة"

steps.action: Tap the distance presets: near, intermediate, distance
steps.expected: Preset selected and the distance read-out changes each time
steps.actual: near:٤٠ سم · الهاتف | intermediate:٦٦ سم · الحاسوب | distance:٦ م+ · اللوحة المرورية

steps.action: Tap the lighting options: dusk, night, then back to day
steps.expected: Lighting changes and the live region announces it
steps.actual: dusk → night → day; live: "أحادية البؤرة. ٦ م+، بعيد · اللوحة المرورية. نهار."

steps.action: Open "كيف تعمل هذه المحاكاة؟" and the sharpness meters
steps.expected: Explanation text and a labelled curve chart appear

steps.action: Check the sharpness bars fill from the reading direction (RTL → from the right)
steps.expected: In Arabic every bar fill starts at the bar's right edge
steps.actual: 3 bars, 1 partly filled; filled from the left (wrong in RTL): 0 [{"fillW":237,"barW":298,"gapRight":1,"gapLeft":60}]

steps.action: Turn on "قارن بين عدستين" and drag the divider with a finger
steps.expected: Second lens shown (two cards, B field); divider moves with the finger

steps.action: Check the simulator controls are finger-sized
Scan the simulator and its section for certainty wording
steps.expected: No "guarantee", "you will see", "20/20" or success percentages
steps.actual: no certainty claims in 2366 characters (negated statements such as "cannot be guaranteed" are allowed)

steps.expected: Lens implants page opens; review-status disclaimer present; no certainty wording
steps.actual: h1="العدسات المزروعة داخل العين"; review notes=2; certainty claims: none; vision simulator still mounted=false
